text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years with Orfevre had passed, and 
on a day when I finally had a bit of 
breathing room—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to train with Orfevre today, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is Dream Journey in the Expedition Support 
Committee room, or has she gone out into 
town...? As I ponder, I suddenly feel a 
breeze.
choice_data_list:
(The weather is great today... which 
means—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? No way!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Why is the Old Hag here?! ...Don't tell 
me, Nakayama-san!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Glad you're cooperating. Right, 
Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, seriously. Goldie's real worried 
about Mame-chin's future...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh...! To think they were conspiring 
together...! I let my guard down, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Ah, Trainer! Good work today, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"She is currently sleeping on the couch 
over there, however."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...So noisy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Are you the one who dares disturb my 
slumber?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm not in the mood.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll adjust the schedule

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. You've certainly gotten more 
sensible.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, do you understand... what I 
desire right now?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre merely raised the corners of her 
mouth. With no other hints... I 
nevertheless searched for what it was she 
truly desired—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In her mind, a gold filigree pendant that 
shouldn't be in her hands gleamed. At the 
same time, in her eyes—"that land" comes 
into view.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Start recording. We're beginning.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"—We interrupt this broadcast with 
breaking news!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre has announced her entry into the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Following last 
year, this marks her second challenge—"

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Look! It's Orfevre. France, huh... Going 
on an overseas trip is still a bit too 
early for me... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
...No, let's go! We should go when we have 
the chance. I'm sure that's part of 
cherishing it, too—

text_block_list.name: Jumbotron
text_block_list.text:
"—We won't be able to take our eyes off 
Triple Crown Umamusume Orfevre this year 
either!"

text_block_list.name: Jumbotron
text_block_list.text:
“Now, speaking of Orfevre! From the wildly 
unconventional, hugely popular band 
'Orfevre', here's the hot track off their 
latest album—”

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Orfe. My eternal king...—

text_block_list.name: Senior Employee
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there you are! Come on, time to head 
to the next promotional stop!

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Alright, let's sell, sell, sell!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Everywhere I go, it's always Orfevre 
this, Orfevre that...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre, Orfevre... Orfevre, 
Orfevre...!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—I don't care how long it takes. That 
name! I'm gonna overwrite it for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light Orfevre radiates ignites a fire 
in people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The wind feels pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: By royal command.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Let me take to the skies.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will hear no complaints. Nor any 
refusal.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Answer swiftly. —Lest my foot finds you 
first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today once again, the King laughs 
tyrannically.
